Q5731.reason: The brother’s interest is measured by the uncle’s life and cuts short the uncle’s life estate if the uncle moves, so it is a shifting executory interest pur autre vie rather than a remainder or a present estate.

Q5115.reason: At exercise onset glycolytic flux rises faster than oxidative clearance, so pyruvate and NADH accumulate and more pyruvate is reduced to lactate.

Q5932.reason: Intermittent high-intensity bursts raise catecholamines, driving hepatic glucose output above muscle uptake, so blood glucose commonly rises about 1–3 mM over 80–90 minutes.
